name: Charter Hall Long WALE REIT
summary: Charter Hall Long WALE REIT is an Australian Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) listed on the ASX and investing in high quality Australasian real estate assets that are predominantly leased to corporate and government tenants on long term leases. Charter Hall Long WALE REIT is managed by Charter Hall Group. Charter Hall is one of Australia's leading fully integrated property investment and funds management groups. They use their expertise to access, deploy, manage and invest equity to create value and generate superior returns for their investor customers.
